subject: Discovery Recap: Private/VPC reqs for Sunnyside Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@sunnysidehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@sunnysidehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery Recap: Private/VPC reqs for Sunnyside Health

Hi Jordan / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Per our call, I wanted to summarize what we heard and confirm next steps so we have alignment on requirements and success criteria.

Summary / pain points
- Regulated workloads (PHI) across clinical workflows; strict HIPAA controls and internal audit requirements.
- Current model endpoints are running in a shared public cloud environment; primary concerns are data residency, egress rules, and key control.
- Ops overhead managing open-source model instances (patching, scaling, cache inefficiencies).
- Need predictable latency for clinician-facing experiences and cost containment for high-volume inference.

Current stack
- Core infra: AWS (VPCs across us-west-2), Databricks for data processing, Postgres for metadata.
- Models: internal fine-tuned LLaMA variants and some vendor models for specific NLU tasks.

Success criteria for an initial engagement / POC
- Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) with no public internet egress from model hosts (or strictly controlled egress to Redwood endpoints via PrivateLink).
- Customer-managed keys (BYOK) with HSM-backed keys for data-at-rest and model artifacts.
- Audit logs for all requests (token-level telemetry optional) and retention policy support (90 days to start; configurable).
- Throughput target: ~100 requests/sec with 95th percentile latency <250ms for typical prompt size (POC workload to be defined).
- Demonstrable data isolation and SOC2 evidence for our security team to review.

Constraints / special considerations
- Possible air-gapped requirement for a limited production subset (on-prem appliance) — need to understand network/ops constraints and timeline.
- Service accounts and SSO integration (SAML/Okta) for RBAC across your team.

Next steps (proposed)
1) You: Share network diagram and a short list of outbound/inbound IPs/ports for our SEs to review (I attached a simple template).
2) Us: Share Redwood Private one-pager and SOC2 Type II (attached) + propose an SE call to deep-dive KMS/HSM options.
3) Schedule: Proposed SE deep-dive — Tue 2026-04-14 11:00am PT or Wed 2026-04-15 9:00am PT.
4) If POC accepted: 4-week technical POC with scope to validate network connectivity, BYOK integration, and latency/throughput baseline.

Attachments: Redwood_Private_VPC_one-pager.pdf, SOC2-Type-II.pdf

Happy to adjust any of the above. Thank you — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Marissa

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@sunnysidehealth.com>

Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@sunnysidehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery Recap: Private/VPC reqs for Sunnyside Health

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

- KMS: We need HSM-backed keys and want BYOK where keys are under our control. AWS KMS w/ CloudHSM would be preferred, but we may need guidance if we choose an on-prem HSM.
- No egress: Ideally model hosts should not have public internet egress. If outbound is required (for updates/metrics), we want it via PrivateLink or our firewall to a limited set of endpoints.
- Air-gap: For the clinical production environment, there's a high chance we will need an air-gapped deployment for a subset of services — can you describe typical on-prem packaging and the support model for that?
- PII handling: Can Redwood provide optional PII redaction hooks (pre- or post-inference) or advise on best practices?
- Cost: a ballpark for a 4-week POC (Private deployment) would help our budget approval.

We'll pull together the network diagram and a short list of required ports by EOD Monday. Also copying Priya (security lead) to loop her in.

Appreciate it — Jordan
Jordan Smith
Technical Program Manager — AI Infrastructure
Sunnyside Health
jordan.smith@sunnysidehealth.com

Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@sunnysidehealth.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery Recap: Private/VPC reqs for Sunnyside Health

Thanks Jordan — great questions. Looping in our SE Dev Patel to run the technical deep-dive and provide a POC estimate.

High-level answers now:
- BYOK/HSM: We support AWS KMS BYOK and CloudHSM for managed keys. For on-prem HSMs we offer an installer that integrates with common HSM vendors and can accept wrapped keys. We'll have Dev share a short doc on options.
- Egress: We support deployment patterns with zero public egress (VPC-only) using VPC peering/PrivateLink or a VPN/Direct Connect arrangement. For telemetry/metrics we can stream to your monitoring endpoints or use an S3 bucket on your network.
- Air-gapped: We have an 'air-gap' installation workflow where we deliver an offline install bundle and a runbook; it requires an on-site engineer for initial install and validation. We'll include the checklist in the SE call.
- PII hooks: Redwood offers optional pre-processing hooks for redaction and post-inference token filters. We can demo this in the POC.

Action items / next steps
- Jordan/Priya: Please send the network diagram and ports spreadsheet (template attached).
- Dev: Can you prepare a short POC plan and a rough cost/time estimate for a 4-week Private deployment POC (include options for AWS Private VPC vs on-prem air-gapped)?
- Marissa/Jordan: Confirm SE deep-dive time (I proposed Tue 4/14 11am PT or Wed 4/15 9am PT).

Attach: initial_network_requirements.xlsx

Thanks — will follow up once Dev confirms availability.

Best,
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@sunnysidehealth.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@sunnysidehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Discovery Recap: Private/VPC reqs for Sunnyside Health — SE follow-up

Hi Jordan / Priya — thanks for the context and Marissa for the intro. Quick technical notes ahead of the SE deep-dive:

Network / connectivity options
- Private VPC: We can deploy Redwood Private inside your AWS VPC (AMI/container) with VPC peering or Transit Gateway. No public egress required.
- PrivateLink: For hosted telemetry or management we can expose specific endpoints as AWS PrivateLink endpoints inside your account.
- On-prem / Air-gap: We provide an offline bundle. On-prem installs require an initial network authorization block to pull updates (can be completely disabled).

Ports / IPs (initial guidance)
- If using Private VPC only: primarily 443 for incoming API traffic from your app subnets; outbound to our control plane can be tunneled over PrivateLink (no public IPs).
- If air-gapped: No outbound connections required. We'll provide an installation VPN session for initial bootstrap if you want remote support.

KMS / HSM
- AWS KMS BYOK: supported; we use envelope encryption. Keys never leave your KMS.
- CloudHSM / on-prem HSM: we support wrapped key import and can integrate with common HSM vendors (Thales, Gemalto, SafeNet).
- Audit: We emit request-level audit logs to a configurable S3 bucket or your SIEM over syslog (TLS).

PII handling
- We can configure pre-inference PII redaction and post-inference token filters. We'll demo a simple regex-based pre-hook and an ML-based scrubber during the POC.

POC estimate (rough)
- Private VPC POC (4 weeks): initial scoping + deploy + baseline tests = ~$18k–$30k (range depends on scale and whether we do model tuning).
- On-prem air-gapped POC (4–6 weeks): additional one-time on-site support fee + packaging = ~$35k–$60k.

Next steps
1) Please share the network diagram and completed ports spreadsheet.
2) Confirm SE deep-dive time (I can do Tue 4/14 11am PT).
3) If you want, we can provision a costed POC SOW draft for your procurement team.

I'll prepare a short SE deck and the BYOK/HSM integration doc for the call.

Cheers,
